summary: Assess technology risks, test control evidence and track remediation using recognized cybersecurity frameworks. Explore this five-day practical course.
lede: Technology risk management assesses exposures and evaluates the evidence for cybersecurity safeguards. For IT risk, cybersecurity GRC and control-assurance practitioners, the course covers rating threats and impact, mapping safeguards, testing control evidence, recording treatment decisions, and tracking remediation. It also addresses third-party service risks, incident lessons, and clear reporting of material exposures to business and technology leaders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess IT and cybersecurity risk, test safeguards, maintain remediation records or prepare assurance and leadership reporting. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with technology risks, control evidence or related governance processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with IT systems or business technology services, plus exposure to risk assessment, cybersecurity controls, audit evidence or assurance workflows. No coding or programming is required for the stated assessment and control-evaluation exercises.
